review_description: On the ball no con bs price, I'm happy

The sales representative was knowledgeable and had some good insights, and no high-pressure tactics.Adapt Energy were upfront about lead times and installation schedules. They were able to quote different system options (not just size, but different panel and battery brands too), it really came down to what I wanted. This made it easy to compare apples-to-apples with other installers.Customer service was great throughout. Every question I had was answered promptly and the team was always courteous and professional.The installation itself was handled with great attention to detail, and the crew was friendly, respectful, and clearly took pride in their work.I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Adapt Energy to anyone considering solar and battery solutions.

Had a few issues but these which were resolved without too much drama. Was mainly a result of the new process with rebates in NSW. Am very happy with the final result with Battery covering power usage so far.

I signed the deal and was very happy with the representative as he really knew his stuff and we added items to update mt existing system and power board. Been over 6 weeks now with deposit paid and no communication from the company. Only an email from Energex . I have no idea what’s going on and when my system will be installed. Representative told me certain things would happen and nothing has. Have not heard from him. I was really excited about the battery and this company because they seemed really great amongst many bad solar companies. But now I don’t know what to think. They need to communicate particularly as I am spending over $16000

Very efficient service. Top quality equipment.  The installation team was great and explained what they were doing. Cleaned up after installation. Helped set up the Ap. That was required, just everything.
So happy we chose Adapt Energy for our solar and battery! The install was stress-free, the team was awesome, and it feels great knowing we’re cutting bills and using our own power.

Adapt Energy were very professional and communicative and spent a good amount of time going through our requirements and answering any questions we had to ensure we ordered the correct system to suit our household. The installers they used, Cooper Solar and Electrical, were excellent. They turned up on time. Their installation was very neat and tidy and they took us through how the system worked and helped us get set up with the system's app – and they were great blokes.

Sales was brilliant as the quote could be updated in real time as we changed the configuration of the system. Our installers from Coronis Solar were on time, informative as they went through each stage as the commenced and finished then explained what was being done next. Our whole experience was very positive with no delays or problems from initial quote to commisioning of the system to the grid.
Fantastic customer service, thanks to Katie by resolving the issue on the battery installation. It’s a quite a drama but it’s a good thing is Adapt look after there customers. Thank you Adapt Solar

Inny, Liam and the team at Adapt Energy were absolutely fantastic to deal with throughout the entire process. From exceptional knowledge and guidance through the consultation, design and grid connection process through to strong relationships with installers of high quality, who were friendly and prompt, cannot speak highly enough of Adapt Energy for all solar and battery needs

Steve and Paul from Adapt Energy were great to work with. They provided a competitive quote using top rated panels and batteries designed to suit my needs. They helped to simply explain aspects I didn’t understand which made the process easy. Highly recommend.

First contact was with Joshua. He came out to the house to discuss the whole project. My experience with Josh was remarkable and essentially the reason I decided to proceed with Adapt Energy. He didn't once apply any sales pressure and remained available for the most important thing I needed - information. He told me he would provide the best price possible and based on other quotes I received, he did exactly that. An impressive young man.The Adapt project team that organised the install were asked by me to keep their word on the installation date and they did. At 7.30am on the 1st of July 2025 (the start date for the Federal Government rebate), the installation team arrived and had completed the project by about 12noon. My system was up and fully operational on day one of the battery rebate scheme. That's frickin efficiency on steroids!!!A huge 'shout out' to Gavin (Adapt Manager) for his assistance and Bronwyn (accounts).Thanks to Dylan Wright and his install team, Harry and Caleb of 'Wright On Electrical' who did a great job who put up with me just sitting there not lifting a finger to help with the entire install - they knew what they were doing.Very happy customer throughout. The battery and app are working extremely well. Thank you to all involved. Lee

Josh from Adapt was super heplful and always willing to answer my many many questions whenever I had one. He didn't try to push me to buy the most expensive thing possible. He had his own preferences and recommendations but was still willing to let me make my own choices without pressuring me too hard towards one product.Installers were polite and efficient and seemed to want to do a thorough careful job of it.

The sales/quoting process was very good and they organised the grid connection for us with a good feed in tariff after installation which saved us a lot of work trying to understand how to do it.The installation was very good.  The installers were very polite, tidy and punctual and showed us how to use the Ap on our phones with patience when dealing with older customersWe chose 14 Aiko panels and a Sungrow inverter.  The reason we went with Adapt Energy was because they were cheaper than other companies quoting for the same solar system
Install yet to be done but very flexible with my situation and amazingly helpful when I had questions.
Very neat and professional installation. Overall a very good experience.

Quote process went very well.Installation process went well, the guys were here when they said they would be, the grid connection was pretty much straight away and the battery is very slick looking and the app is amazing lots of figures and graphs, great usable information..
Excellent sales process, clear information and no pressure sale welcoming comparison to other providers. Happened also to have most competitive price in first quote.

Mark came to my home to quote me on solar panels. He explained everything to me and answered all my questions. I had another 2 quotes from other companies and 1 of the other quotes came in with a bigger and more efficient system.  It was hard to decide as the other company was fantastic as well. I ended up going with adapt energy as it was a bigger company, has after sales support, registered all my warranties, is local to my area and had the fronius inverter and amazing service. The only concern I have Is the Aiko panels as they are new but I decided it was worth the chance.The installation was faultless and the crew was amazing. I’m now eagerly waiting to see my next electrical bill!

The installation was excellent, but things aren’t so good at the moment. When my system was first installed with 4 aircons and overhead fans running all night I still had around 70% in the battery first thing in the morning. But as of last Sunday morning (13/4/25) there was only 35% in the battery and this was with only 1 aircon and 3 fans.And then this morning Monday 14/4/25 with no aircons and 1 fan there was only 48% in the battery.I sent an email to Adapt on Sunday morning which has been referred to their operations Department, but as of now I haven’t received an answer. To me it seems that perhaps the power from my battery is being sent to the grid overnight, but of course I could be wrong and it might be a fault with my battery which is a Power Wall 3.Also I have noted that power production from my panels seems to drop off around midday.Regards ,Adrian

- Sales conversations were very easy and informative, with minimal sales tactics or pressure.- Installers did a fantastic job, were prompt, respectful and understanding of having young kids at home.- Great customer service
Just had system installed and monitoring performance. Sales process very good allowing options to be explored. Installation team very through and determined.

Sales process - excellent.Installation process - terrible. Problems ordering stock etc is fine but then lack of any communication about this led to a great deal of friction. Did not attend when they said they would.Customer service - Operations team was ok once involved to smooth over the problems with the local installer.
Steve is very professional, he helped me understand fully the ins and outs of the initially daunting world of solar. My local installer was on time and very tidy. I would recommend Adapt to others.

Hi Team,I would like to say a massive thank you for the whole experience, stress free and easy.The girls on the phone we're very professional and easy to talk to considering i know nothing about solar.  Gavin was amazing, he explained to me how it all works and sent the drone up to look at my roof to give me a real life shot of how it would look on my roof.  I like that this company only uses the best panels and inverters.  The 3 young guys that came on the day to install the system where amazing.  Very friendly, super professional, very hard working and you could tell they love what they do as they didnt stop and are super proud of their work.The whole process was completed in less than 2 weeks, the easiest thing I have ever done.  Thank you again
Prompt responses at all times. The installation team were first class. Absolutely outstanding. Nothing was too much trouble. They were happy, tidy and friendly.

On both occasions I phoned Adapt Energy for quote to install a solar and a solar/battery system. After sending recent power bills I had my quote to supply and install within 24hrs.On both occasions installation went smoothly. Installation staff were efficient courteous and removed all rubbish from site(s).All discussions with Energy providers was done by Adapt Energy on my behalf.Tuition in operation of equipment was provided. I do find reassuring Adapt Energy's monitoring via internet.I would have no hesitation(and I have) recommending Adapt Energy

Although the installation was great, the after sales service is absolutely poor. I have complained three times about the incomplete connection for the essential circuits and no response other than contact from the after sales service team. Plenty excuses - COVID through the office, we'll contact the installation sub-contractor".i had a power outage on 22 November and there was no back up supply from the battery.There was a lack of instruction from the installers other than "it is all done and it is set and forget".Perhaps Finn Peacock ought to include ratings for after sales service.Would I recommend Adapt Energy? Not based on after sales service.This then reflects on Finn's reputation to recommend solar companies.

All the steps from the initial quotation through to installation went very smoothly. Adapt Energy were very transparent with all the details and their customer service was excellent. I was given the choice to select the Inverter and panel brands that i wanted after researching all options.
Adapt Energy offer a knowledgeable, friendly and well-priced service. I have no trouble recommending Adapt Energy to anyone looking to install solar

Adapt Energy where very easy to deal with and answered all my questions in a way which was easy to understand.Installation went smoothly and installers cleaned up and left area clean and tidy taking my old system away with them.  They actually came a day earlier then planned which worked out better as it rained the planned day.Very happy customer

Tyson, the sales contact at Adapt, has a very good understanding of the energy infrastructure, power usage & available product knowledge & performance.  After working through our power usage based on our past bills Tyson recommended an increase of 6.5 Kw to our existing 6Kw solar system & a battery size of at least 10Kwh to achieve a our goal of eliminating our monthly power bill. We customised a system to maximise energy production & storage to negate future power bills. All choices relating to the increased solar system size, solar panels, battery & inverter were left to my wife & I.The installation was complete in 4 hours & the staff were punctual, tidy & left the site clean when finished. We had no issues with the grid connection or battery & inverter software. We are a month into our solar battery journey & are more than happy with systems performance to date.

Adapt Energy were a great company to deal with from start to finish. They were extremely helpful and honest when I reached out to them for advice regarding installing a new solar system at our house. Their communication was great throughout, and I felt like everyone I spoke to was genuine and honest with their advice. The installation process was also hassle-free, the installers were polite and tidy with their work. They also showed us how to use the system and related app once installed. Would highly recommend to anyone, and would use again if needed in the future.

I can’t recommend Adapt Energy highly enough for a solar installation. I was referred to them through the Solar Quotes website. I first reached out to Cam and Bronwyn from Adapt back in June to discuss the installation. At the same time, I was also getting my roof restored, but due to various issues with tradesmen, I had to reschedule and push back the installation because the roof restoration wasn’t completed as promised. Cam and Bronwyn were incredibly understanding of my situation and patient with all the date changes I had to request.On installation day, everything went smoothly. Sam and his team were professional, friendly, and did a neat job with the installation. I’ve been using the system for about two months now, and I have no complaints at all.

I recently had solar panels installed by Adapt Energy, and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From the initial consultation to the final installation, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and dedicated to ensuring everything went smoothly. They took the time to answer all my questions and made sure I understood the process. The installation was done on time and with great attention to detail. I highly recommend Adapt Energy for anyone considering solar panels!"
I asked a lot of questions to understand what was being offered.The installation was no trouble and the team finished all in one day.Adapt followed up the installation to see if I was satisfied.
Great system at a good price.  Easy to work with.  Installation team were quick, efficient and tidy. Final product is excellent!
Adapt energy was a great company to deal with. Transparent flow of information and great communication.

Adapt Energy were the obvious choice for us. Steve listened to what we were trying to achieve and then gave us three good options without trying to persuade us to move arrays or opt for different panels or inverters etc. For aesthetic reasons we wanted the system on the South side of the house, he accepted this challenge without trying to convince us to move it  to the North as other quoters did. All the paperwork etc was taken care of by Adapt and the installation date confirmed quickly. Install day coincided with rain but the guys did their best to work around this, and rearranged their schedule accordingly.

Firstly Mark impressed us with his explanation of the solar options and his promise to come back to us to after the installation.The installers did a very tidy professional job managing to avoid any unsightly cabling.
Efficient, polite, tidy, pleasant, helpful, on time, all good. System explained well.

Adapt Energy have surprised me with their customer service. The sales wasn't pushy, and eventually they aligned with what I was looking for. The installation was smooth, and so far in the first week, the system is working well. Well done Sam the electrician who did the install.

We had an over all very good experience from our initial contact with Owain, in sales, to installation and support from the installation team. We really don’t have anything negative to say. In our opinion Adapt Energy are an excellent company with a very good quality product.

Installation was completed on a terracotta roof with a couple of steep slopes.  Inverter nicely tucked away on our garage wall. Team were polite and professional.  They had to return to remedy a small issue but were very quick to do so.
Prompt efficient smooth experience. Polite tidy punctual very helpful especially with the Phone app.

The quotation process was quick and satisfactory. Our requirements were well understood and reflected in the quotation. The installation was also excellent. The work was neat and clean and excellent explanations were given on how the battery works together with the solar system. I am very happy with the system and the installation.After the installation I received a phone call asking if everything was satisfactory and if there were any questions. I can also call in the future with questions about the system, excellent customer service!
Installation was easy and no problems. The installer made it a pressure. Time will tell if it was wearth it.

Adapt Energy was quick to respond with a great quote taking into consideration our unique situation. Installation was done within a week and handover was informative. All in all a pleasant experience and we're very happy with the outcome - all at a comfortable price.

1. It was a professional and a detailed quote2. Brought the installation day forward as they had a cancellation. The crew was punctual and professional.3. Service was as expected.however it took nearly a month to send me the after installation paperwork which I was not too concerned about.
Sales team and customer service have been professional, friendly and responsive. Very happy with their service.
